title: UK Car Finance Compensation Scheme Paused After Legal Challenge, Delaying Payouts Until 2027 or Later
author: James O'Connor
image: /images/news/UK FCA Partially Suspends Motor Finance Redress Scheme, Delaying Billions in Compensation.webp
excerpt: The UK Financial Conduct Authority has partially suspended its £9.1 billion motor finance redress scheme after legal challenges, delaying compensation payments to millions of motorists until at least 2027.

title: Stock Market Today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq Swing as Tech Stocks Trigger Global Market Volatility
author: Finance Desk
image: /images/news/Global Markets Turn Mixed as Tech Volatility Drives Uneven.webp
excerpt: Global equities ended mixed as tech-driven volatility weighed on U.S. indexes, while Asian markets prepared for a choppy open amid uncertain investor sentiment.

title: Investors Pile Into Dollar Bets After Kevin Warsh Signals Tougher Fed Stance
author: Finance Desk
excerpt: Investors are increasing bullish bets on the U.S. dollar after Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh signaled a more hawkish policy approach, prompting markets to reconsider interest-rate expectations.

title: Yen Hits 40-Year Low as Japan Faces Mounting Pressure Over FX Intervention and Policy Gap
author: Finance Desk
image: /images/news/Yen Hits 40-Year Low as Japan Faces Mounting Pressure Over FX Intervention an.webp
excerpt: The Japanese yen has fallen to near 40-year lows against the U.S. dollar, prompting renewed warnings of potential FX intervention as policy divergence and rate gaps continue to pressure the currency.

title: More Americans Say Their Finances Are Worse Than a Year Ago, Fed Survey Finds
author: David Smith
excerpt: A Federal Reserve survey shows more Americans believe their financial condition has worsened compared with a year ago, while inflation expectations, debt concerns and economic uncertainty continue to weigh on households.

title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Posts Record Quarter as AI Infrastructure Demand Soars
author: Sarah Wu
excerpt: HPE reported record quarterly revenue as demand for AI infrastructure, servers and networking products surged, prompting the company to raise its financial outlook.

title: Global Markets Retreat as AI Stock Selloff and Rising Oil Prices Rattle Investors
author: David Smith
excerpt: Global stock markets declined as investors reacted to a selloff in AI-related shares, rising oil prices and renewed concerns over inflation and geopolitical tensions in the Middle East.
